wire-dispenser-4x2x9.title: Wire dispenser crate 4x2x9
wire-dispenser-4x2x9.blurb: Holds 6 spools of 52 x 23 mm (hole 12) on a lift-out axle; pull each colour through its own rounded eyelet in the front wall. Pinch slot between the middle eyelets parks a cut end.
wire-dispenser-4x2x9.print_notes: Upright, no supports: the eyelet ledge has a 45 deg underside and the 2.6 mm eyelets bridge cleanly. 3 walls, 15% infill. Ream eyelets with a 2.5 mm drill if your printer runs tight. No divider slots on this variant.

wire-cradle-frame-4x2x9.title: Spool cradle frame 4x2x9
wire-cradle-frame-4x2x9.blurb: Drops onto the dispenser floor: two open-top U-cradles hold the axle so you lift the whole spool set out to swap one. Rails locate it against the end walls.
wire-cradle-frame-4x2x9.print_notes: Flat on its rails, U-cradles up, no supports. 3 walls, 20% infill.

wire-axle-8mm.title: Spool axle 8 mm
wire-axle-8mm.blurb: 8 mm rod, 161.5 mm long. Or skip printing: cut an 8 mm steel rod or M8 threaded rod to the same length.
wire-axle-8mm.material: PETG (stiffer and less creep-prone than PLA under the spool load)
wire-axle-8mm.print_notes: Lying on its 0.5 mm flat along X, no supports, 4 walls, 40% infill; needs a bed at least 165 mm long (print diagonally on smaller beds).

wire-spool-washer-8mm.title: Spool spacer washer
wire-spool-washer-8mm.blurb: 18/8.6 x 1.5 mm washer between neighbouring spools so each spins on its own. Print 5.
wire-spool-washer-8mm.print_notes: Flat, no supports, 100% infill. Smooth side (bed side) toward a spool.
